title: Merchant map frontmatter (finance/knowledge/merchant-map.md)
description: Learned meanings of transaction descriptions: who the counterparty is, what category, and whether it is a real expense/income or an internal transfer. Built during onboarding, grown monthly.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the field selected by 'field' (default: the normalized transaction description).

field.description: Which transaction field the pattern matches. counterparty rules are how one-legged internal transfers to own sub-accounts are recognized when descriptions carry per-transaction entropy.

kind.description: internal_transfer entries are candidates for the transfer matcher, never counted as income/expense.

confirmed.description: True once the user has verified this mapping; unconfirmed mappings are re-surfaced for review.
